# JR's Device Care

> Phone, tablet & laptop repair workshop in Newlands West, Durban — plus the JR's Device Care Academy, a 2–3 week hands-on training program for aspiring electronics technicians.

JR's Device Care fixes cracked screens, dead batteries, charging ports, water damage and software issues on all major phone, tablet and laptop brands (iPhone, Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, Lenovo, HP, and more). Repairs come with a 30-day warranty and OEM parts. Bookings and quotes happen on WhatsApp at 071 686 5256.

The Academy enrols 20 students per intake (next intake: April 2026) at R5,000 per student for a full hands-on electronics repair curriculum.
